name: SFS Real Estate Investment Trust
source: SFS Real Estate Investment Trust 2025 Annual Report & Accounts, audited (DoC Advisory, signed March 2026). Figures read from the fund's own statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. N'000 converted to absolute NGN. source_url https://sfsreit.com/pdf/relations/sfs-reit-annual-report-2025.pdf
source_note: Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income: Total income N717,386k, Total operating expenses N88,899k, Net Income N628,487k, Net income per unit N31.42. A fair value gain of N3,483,050k on investment properties, from the IAS 40 fair value model adopted in 2025, takes total comprehensive profit to N4,111,537k; the panel's income schema has no row for that gain, so the fair value movement is recorded here and not allocated to a row. 2024 comparatives are the audited figures printed in the same statement. The fund prints no income tax line and no finance cost line, so operating result and net income are the same figure.
